commits.subject: fix(cli): fetch-contest-streak doesn't DM on the expected settlement lag
commits.body:
The currentness gate DM'd on every fetch where the profile lagged our latest
pick — which is the NORMAL morning state (the contest settles day D the next
day), so it fired a 'failed' DM daily. Now level-aware (reuses
resolved_pick_settlement_gap): a 1-settled-pick lag refuses to overwrite but
exits 0 with no DM; >=2 picks behind is genuine staleness and still alerts.
Same false-alarm class as the H2 health-check fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
